timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,410 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly—the exchange rate has fallen to 1,410 won per dollar, a 10-month low, meaning you need fewer won to purchase your $2,000. The news reports a sharp 125 won decline over one month and 107 won drop in July alone, indicating sustained won strength against the dollar.

TIP: Lock in this conversion soon, as the won appears near multi-month peaks; if it weakens further (rates rise above 1,410), your monthly $2,000 will cost more won.
